sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日新闻简报 DealBook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a special episode of
sentences.zh: 这是一期特别节目的

sentences.en: The Daily.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, Michael Flynn pleads guilty to lying to the FBI, saying he's cooperating with the Mueller investigation.
sentences.zh: 今天，迈克尔·弗林对向联邦调查局撒谎的罪名表示认罪，并称他正在配合穆勒的调查。

sentences.en: What it tells us, that prosecutors have a senior member of the Trump
sentences.zh: 这告诉我们，检方已经让特朗普

sentences.en: White House on their side.
sentences.zh: 白宫的高层成员站到了他们这一边。

sentences.en: It's Friday afternoon, December 1St. We begin with the significant sign that former National Security Advisor Michael Flynn could be cooperating with Robert Mueller,
sentences.zh: 今天是12月1日星期五。我们首先关注到一个重要迹象：前国家安全顾问迈克尔·弗林可能正在配合罗伯特·穆勒的调查，

sentences.en: the special counsel leading this whole Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·穆勒是领导整个俄罗斯调查的特别检察官。

sentences.en: Flynn's lawyers told White House lawyers they could no longer discuss defense strategy with them.
sentences.zh: 弗林的律师告诉白宫律师，他们不能再与他们讨论辩护策略。

sentences.en: This guy that Trump was very close to is going to be flipping, essentially, to talk to the other side about what he knows with
sentences.zh: 这个特朗普曾经非常亲近的人，基本上要反水了，去和另一方谈谈他所了解的关于

sentences.en: Russia.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯的情况。

sentences.en: Mike, when did you hear that Michael Flynn was going to plead guilty to charges of lying to the FBI?
sentences.zh: 迈克，你是什么时候听说迈克尔·弗林要对向联邦调查局撒谎的指控认罪的？

sentences.en: Well, this all for us goes back to nine days ago, eight days ago on Thanksgiving when I was
sentences.zh: 嗯，对我们来说，这一切要追溯到九天前、八天前的感恩节，当时我

sentences.en: in the car with my family driving to Philadelphia, and I got a call that Flynn had pulled out of this joint defense agreement with the president.
sentences.zh: 正和家人坐在开车去费城的车里，我接到一个电话，说弗林退出了与总统的联合辩护协议。

sentences.en: Mike Schmidt is an investigative reporter at the Times.
sentences.zh: 迈克·施密特是《时报》的一名调查记者。

sentences.en: Flynn's lawyers and the president's lawyers had been sharing information because they were on the same side of things.
sentences.zh: 弗林的律师和总统的律师一直在共享信息，因为他们在同一阵营。

sentences.en: But Flynn had pulled out of this agreement in a signal that he was cooperating.
sentences.zh: 但弗林退出了这项协议，这是一个他正在进行配合的信号。

sentences.en: You can't stay in that agreement if you're going to be on the other side of things.
sentences.zh: 如果你打算站在另一边，你就无法留在那个协议中。

sentences.en: So we're working our way through traffic in Maryland, and I get this call.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正堵在马里兰州的交通里，我接到了这个电话。

sentences.en: I turned to my dad, who's in the passenger seat, and I said, Dad, Flynn may have flipped.
sentences.zh: 我转向坐在副驾驶座上的父亲，我说，爸，弗林可能反水了。

sentences.en: I need you to drive.
sentences.zh: 我需要你来开车。

sentences.en: And he looks at me with this look like, you will literally do anything to get out of driving.
sentences.zh: 他看着我的眼神好像在说：你为了不驾车简直什么都做得出来。

sentences.en: So what you just learned at that moment was that Flynn's lawyer had ended a kind of mutual compact with the president's lawyers in which they were cooperating, sharing information.
sentences.zh: 所以你当时了解到的是，弗林的律师终止了与总统律师之间的一种相互契约，根据该契约，他们曾一直在合作、共享信息。

sentences.en: And the minute that you learned that, you immediately suspect or intuit that that means that Flynn is going from
sentences.zh: 而一旦你了解到这一点，你就会立刻怀疑或直觉地认为，这意味着弗林正从

sentences.en: talking and maybe even working with the White House to working with federal prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 与白宫交谈甚至可能为其工作，转变为与联邦检察官合作。

sentences.en: It's a legalese thing, but at the end of the day, it's a signal that Flynn was going to flip and
sentences.zh: 这是一个法律术语层面的事情，但归根结底，这是一个信号，表明弗林将要反水，

sentences.en: Flynn was going to cooperate.
sentences.zh: 弗林将要进行配合。

sentences.en: And in the end, it turns out to be a fairly important thing, obviously, now that he has begun cooperating and pled guilty.
sentences.zh: 最后，事实证明这是一件相当重要的事情，显然，现在他已经开始配合并认罪了。

sentences.en: Lock him up!
sentences.zh: 把他关起来！

sentences.en: Lock him up!
sentences.zh: 把他关起来！

sentences.en: Lock him up!
sentences.zh: 把他关起来！

sentences.en: So give us the scene this morning at the courthouse in Washington as this becomes a reality.
sentences.zh: 那么，请给我们描述一下今天早上华盛顿法院的现场，随着这一切成为现实。

sentences.en: At 10.30 this morning, Mike Flynn, who at the beginning of this year was the president's national security advisor, the top national security official in the government, walks into
sentences.zh: 今天上午10点30分，今年年初担任总统国家安全顾问、政府最高国家安全官员的迈克尔·弗林，走进了

sentences.en: the federal courthouse in downtown Washington and pleads guilty to lying to the FBI about the nature of his calls with the Russian ambassador during the transition.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿市中心的联邦法院，并对在过渡期间与俄罗斯大使通话的性质向联邦调查局撒谎的罪名表示认罪。

sentences.en: And pleading guilty, as Flynn did, signifies that he's now cooperating with the government, right?
sentences.zh: 正如弗林所做的那样，认罪意味着他现在正在与政府合作，对吗？

sentences.en: Well, it's not just that he pleads guilty.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不仅仅是他认罪了。

sentences.en: He agrees to cooperate with the government.
sentences.zh: 他同意与政府合作。

sentences.en: He agrees to tell them about any type of crime that has been committed.
sentences.zh: 他同意告知他们关于已经发生的任何类型的犯罪。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So tell us about what Flynn pled guilty to lying to the FBI about.
sentences.zh: 那么请告诉我们，弗林因对联邦调查局撒谎的罪名具体涉及什么。

sentences.en: One we already know about, right?
sentences.zh: 其中一个我们已经知道了，对吧？

sentences.en: It's the reason he left the White House just a month into the new Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 这就是他在新特朗普政府上台仅一个月后离开白宫的原因。

sentences.en: He was found to have lied about a telephone conversation with the Russian ambassador.
sentences.zh: 人们发现他对与俄罗斯大使的一次电话交谈撒了谎。

sentences.en: Remind us what went down in that case.
sentences.zh: 提醒我们那起案件是如何发生的。

sentences.en: There were two calls that are in question.
sentences.zh: 有两次通话受到质疑。

sentences.en: The first one was around a vote shortly before Christmas in which the U.N.
sentences.zh: 第一次是在圣诞节前不久的一次投票前后，当时联合国

sentences.en: Security Council was going to vote on whether to condemn Israel on the building of settlements.
sentences.zh: 安全理事会将就谴责以色列定居点建设进行投票。

sentences.en: As part of that, we learned today,
sentences.zh: 作为其中的一部分，我们今天得知，

sentences.en: Flynn had lobbied the Russian ambassador to vote in Israel's favor.
sentences.zh: 弗林曾游说俄罗斯大使投赞成以色列的票。

sentences.en: What we also learned today is that
sentences.zh: 我们今天还得知，

sentences.en: Flynn had lied to the FBI about that.
sentences.zh: 弗林曾就此事向联邦调查局撒谎。

sentences.en: The second call is one that happens on December 29th in which
sentences.zh: 第二次通话发生在12月29日，当时

sentences.en: Flynn talks to the ambassador about sanctions.
sentences.zh: 弗林与大使谈论了制裁问题。

sentences.en: The Obama administration has just announced that they are imposing sanctions on Russia for their meddling in the election.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马政府刚刚宣布对俄罗斯干预选举实施制裁。

sentences.en: And Flynn calls the ambassador, we learn, to reassure him to sort of sit tight and not do anything and wait until they get into office.
sentences.zh: 我们得知，弗林打电话给大使，是为了安抚他，让他按兵不动，什么都不要做，等到他们上台。

sentences.en: So this Israel call, I don't think I knew about that one before.
sentences.zh: 所以关于以色列的这个电话，我想我之前并不知道。

sentences.en: No, this is something new.
sentences.zh: 不，这是新情况。

sentences.en: And it's as part of this story, we go along, we get different facts and chip away as we move forward.
sentences.zh: 随着这个故事的推进，我们不断获得不同的事实，并在前进的过程中一点点剥茧抽丝。

sentences.en: And what we learned today is about what happens before this vote.
sentences.zh: 我们今天了解到的就是这次投票之前发生的事情。

sentences.en: Benjamin Netanyahu calls the transition team and says, look, I need your help with this U.N.
sentences.zh: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡致电过渡团队，说，听着，我需要你们在这场联合国

sentences.en: Security
sentences.zh: 安全

sentences.en: Council vote.
sentences.zh: 理事会投票中给予帮助。

sentences.en: The Obama administration is going to allow it to happen.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马政府将允许它发生。

sentences.en: And I need you to lobby other countries on our behalf.
sentences.zh: 我需要你们代表我们游说其他国家。

sentences.en: The transition team thought this was a really important issue.
sentences.zh: 过渡团队认为这是一个非常重要的问题。

sentences.en: And Flynn, along with Jared Kushner, Trump's son-in-law, begin lobbying other countries on Israel's behalf.
sentences.zh: 弗林与特朗普的女婿贾里德·库什纳一起，开始代表以色列游说其他国家。

sentences.en: And the second call, the one we had heard about before, Flynn reassures Russia that sanctions that have
sentences.zh: 而在第二次通话中，也就是我们之前听说过的那次，弗林向俄罗斯保证，即将卸任的总统奥巴马

sentences.en: been imposed by President Obama, the outgoing president, he and the incoming president, Donald
sentences.zh: 实施的制裁，他和当选总统唐纳德·

sentences.en: Trump, they're not going to take them that seriously.
sentences.zh: 特朗普并不会那么认真对待。

sentences.en: And they're going to try to unravel them.
sentences.zh: 他们会试图取消这些制裁。

sentences.en: It's sit tight, don't retaliate, is the message that Flynn conveys to the Russian ambassador.
sentences.zh: 弗林向俄罗斯大使传达的信息是：按兵不动，不要报复。

sentences.en: Which is to say, Flynn is telling the Russians, these sanctions that are being imposed against you, this new administration, we're going to have a whole new approach.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，弗林在告诉俄罗斯人，针对你们实施的这些制裁，我们这个新政府将采取全新的方法。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: As you recall, Donald Trump, either as a candidate or in office, has said basically nothing critical about Russia and has made improving relations with Russia a central part
sentences.zh: 你还记得，唐纳德·特朗普无论作为候选人还是在任期间，基本上没有对俄罗斯发表过任何批评言论，并将改善与俄罗斯的关系作为其纲领的

sentences.en: of his platform.
sentences.zh: 核心部分。

sentences.en: So these are two cases in which Michael Flynn, acting on behalf of the Trump transition team,
sentences.zh: 所以这是两起案件，迈克尔·弗林代表特朗普过渡团队，

sentences.en: talks to the Russian ambassador about actions that the Obama administration, which is still in power, is about to take or has just taken that involved Russia.
sentences.zh: 与俄罗斯大使谈论了仍然在任的奥巴马政府即将采取或刚刚采取的涉及俄罗斯的行动。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The Trump transition team was in this weird, unchartered territory where they were
sentences.zh: 特朗普过渡团队处于这种奇怪的、未知的领域，当时

sentences.en: trying to get involved in foreign policy matters when there was still an administration in office.
sentences.zh: 在仍然有政府在任的情况下，他们试图干预外交政策事务。

sentences.en: Most, if not all, prior administrations have respected the fact that there's one administration at a time and that it can take its actions.
sentences.zh: 多数（如果不是全部）前届政府都尊重这样一个事实，即一次只能有一个政府在任，并且它可以采取自己的行动。

sentences.en: What's different here is that there was a lot going on on the transition team side where they were trying to play foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 这里不同的是，过渡团队方面发生了很多事情，他们试图扮演外交政策的角色。

sentences.en: And that was something that has gotten them into a lot of trouble.
sentences.zh: 而这正是让他们陷入大量麻烦的事情。

sentences.en: So it's clearly illegal to have lied to the FBI about this stuff.
sentences.zh: 因此，就这些事情向联邦调查局撒谎显然是违法的。

sentences.en: But are the actions themselves not illegal?
sentences.zh: 但这些行为本身难道不违法吗？

sentences.en: There's some question about whether Flynn's discussions with foreign governments while the Obama administration was still in office violated something called the Logan Act.
sentences.zh: 关于在奥巴马政府仍在任职期间弗林与外国政府的讨论是否违反了所谓的《洛根法案》，存在一些疑问。

sentences.en: But it doesn't appear that there was anything inherently wrong with the conversations.
sentences.zh: 但这些对话本身似乎并没有什么本质上的错误。

sentences.en: But where Flynn runs into trouble is when he tries to talk to the FBI about it and answer its questions about what he was talking to Kislyak, the ambassador, about.
sentences.zh: 然而弗林陷入麻烦的地方在于，当他试图向联邦调查局谈及此事，并回答关于他与大使基斯利亚克谈论了什么的问题时。

sentences.en: So presumably, in any case, Flynn will not be charged with anything further than what he has, right, given that he is now cooperating with the special counsel?
sentences.zh: 所以可以推测，无论如何，鉴于弗林现在正在与特别检察官合作，他不会被起诉比现有罪名更多的罪名，对吗？

sentences.en: No, that's not necessarily true.
sentences.zh: 不，这不一定正确。

sentences.en: Flynn has criminal exposure on several other issues, including his work for foreign governments
sentences.zh: 弗林在其他几个问题上还面临刑事风险，包括他为外国政府的工作，

sentences.en: and whether he tried to arrange a kidnapping of a Turkish exile in the United States on behalf of the Turkish government.
sentences.zh: 以及他是否曾代表土耳其政府试图策划在美国绑架一名土耳其异见人士。

sentences.en: Those things were not mentioned in the charging documents today, but are matters the special counsel has been looking at.
sentences.zh: 这些事情在今天的起诉书中没有被提及，但却是特别检察官一直在调查的事项。

sentences.en: But you have to understand when someone cooperates, the government is more likely to allow them to plead to lesser charges in exchange for the information that they're providing.
sentences.zh: 但你必须明白，当某人进行合作时，政府更有可能允许他们对较轻的罪名认罪，以此来换取他们提供的信息。

sentences.en: So by Mueller not charging Flynn with other things, he can hold things back and continue to have leverage over him as he forces him to cooperate and tell him everything he knows.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过不以其他罪名起诉弗林，穆勒可以有所保留，并在迫使弗林合作并说出他所知道的一切时，继续对其实施控制。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this is the first senior White House official to cooperate.
sentences.zh: 这是第一位合作的高级白宫官员。

sentences.en: Does the fact that the government has chosen to offer Flynn a deal suggest that he has information
sentences.zh: 政府选择与弗林达成交易这一事实，是否表明他掌握了

sentences.en: on someone they think to be an even more significant target within the Trump campaign or administration than Flynn?
sentences.zh: 他们认为在特朗普竞选团队或政府内部比弗林更重要目标的有关信息？

sentences.en: When you're the national security advisor, there aren't that many more people left above you.
sentences.zh: 当你担任国家安全顾问时，你上面剩下的人已经不多了。

sentences.en: What we know about the Justice Department and about Bob Mueller's history is that they do not offer pleas to people who do not have things to give.
sentences.zh: 我们对司法部和鲍勃·穆勒历史的了解是，他们不会向没有东西可提供的人提供认罪协议。

sentences.en: And in this case, you have to think if they are going to allow someone who has such criminal
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，你必须考虑到，如果他们允许一个面临如此大刑事风险的人

sentences.en: exposure to take a plea agreement, then he has some cards, some information that Mueller really wants and needs.
sentences.zh: 达成认罪协议，那么他手中确实有一些底牌，有一些穆勒真正想要和需要的信息。

sentences.en: I mean, look, the biggest questions here are what does Flynn know about what Trump knew about the conversations with the Russians and what does Flynn know about the campaign's
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，看，这里最大的问题是，弗林对特朗普关于与俄罗斯人对话的知情情况了解多少，弗林对竞选团队

sentences.en: efforts to work or collude with the Russians or to get information from them?
sentences.zh: 与俄罗斯人合作或勾结或从他们那里获取信息的努力了解多少？

sentences.en: As we know, the Russians had promised the campaign damaging, incriminating information on Hillary
sentences.zh: 众所周知，俄罗斯人曾向竞选团队承诺提供关于希拉里·克林顿的破坏性、

sentences.en: Clinton.
sentences.zh: incriminating 的信息。

sentences.en: There are a lot of questions about connections between the Trump campaign and Russia that if there is a there there, Flynn should be able to answer.
sentences.zh: 关于特朗普竞选团队与俄罗斯之间的联系，有很多疑问，如果其中确实存在猫腻，弗林应该能够回答。

sentences.en: Michael, is the suspicion or perhaps the theory that the president might have requested that
sentences.zh: 迈克，人们的怀疑或某种理论可能是总统曾经要求

sentences.en: Flynn make these calls or that he might have been aware of it?
sentences.zh: 弗林进行这些通话，或者他可能对此知情？

sentences.en: And if either of those are true, how much does that change the course of the special counsel's investigation?
sentences.zh: 如果这两者之一是真的，这将在多大程度上改变特别检察官调查的进程？

sentences.en: But that's the thing.
sentences.zh: 但关键就在这里。

sentences.en: It doesn't appear that there's anything illegal about the fact that these conversations happened.
sentences.zh: 这些对话发生的事实本身似乎并没有什么非法的。

sentences.en: So why is it that Flynn went to such lengths to lie about it?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么弗林要大费周章地撒谎呢？

sentences.en: And even if Trump knew about it, there's nothing necessarily wrong with that.
sentences.zh: 即使特朗普知道这件事，这也未必有什么不对。

sentences.en: But the question here is that why did they go to such lengths to mislead and lie about it?
sentences.zh: 但这里的问题是，他们为什么要大费周章地误导和撒谎呢？

sentences.en: What was it that led them to do that?
sentences.zh: 是什么导致他们这样做的？

sentences.en: Is that simply just the instincts of this administration where they fall back on not wanting to be candid?
sentences.zh: 这仅仅是本届政府不愿坦诚相待的本能吗？

sentences.en: Or is there something larger that was going on here that they were trying to distract from and and not admit to?
sentences.zh: 还是这里发生了更重大事情，他们试图转移视线并且不愿承认？

sentences.en: We know that the campaign sought out information that the Russians said they had on Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 我们知道竞选团队寻找了俄罗斯人声称掌握的关于希拉里·克林顿的信息。

sentences.en: But beyond that, we don't really know what the true nature of the relationship was.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，我们并不真正知道这种关系的真实性质是什么。

sentences.en: So, Mike, as I always want to know when I talk to you about this investigation, what does this
sentences.zh: 所以，迈克，正如我每次和你讨论这项调查时都想知道的那样，

sentences.en: development mean to you as someone who is reporting on all of this so closely every day?
sentences.zh: 作为一个每天如此密切报道这一切的人，这一进展对你意味着什么？

sentences.en: First of all, there had been a notion being pushed by the White House that Mueller was going to be done by the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 首先，白宫曾有一种观点认为穆勒将在年底前结束调查。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I didn't believe it at the time, and I believe it less so today.
sentences.zh: 我当时不信，今天更不信了。

sentences.en: To the president's huge frustration, I imagine.
sentences.zh: 我想这让总统感到无比沮丧。

sentences.en: It is something that has dogged them from day one and continues as we come into the end of the first year to be something that they cannot move
sentences.zh: 这件事从第一天起就一直困扰着他们，随着第一年接近尾声，它依然是他们无法

sentences.en: paSt. It is quite remarkable that the campaign chairman and the former national security advisor have now both been charged in connection with this.
sentences.zh: 跨过去的一道坎。竞选主席和前国家安全顾问现在都因与此相关的罪名被起诉，这相当引人注目。

sentences.en: Every time that this story looks like it may have petered out or hit a top, it breaks through into a new area.
sentences.zh: 每当这个故事看起来可能已经平息或到达顶点时，它就会突破到一个新的领域。

sentences.en: And at this point, that doesn't surprise me anymore.
sentences.zh: 到了这个时候，这已经让我不再感到惊讶了。

sentences.en: But I do find it quite remarkable because there have been different periods in the past year where I've thought maybe this story has gone as far as it can go.
sentences.zh: 但我确实觉得这相当引人注目，因为过去一年中有不同的时期，我曾认为这个故事可能已经走到了尽头。

sentences.en: So then where do you think this investigation goes next?
sentences.zh: 那么你认为这项调查接下来会走向何方？

sentences.en: The central question will be what does Flynn have to offer to Mueller?
sentences.zh: 核心问题将是弗林能为穆勒提供什么？

sentences.en: What does he know?
sentences.zh: 他知道些什么？

sentences.en: And how does that help Mueller advance his investigation?
sentences.zh: 这又将如何帮助穆勒推进他的调查？

sentences.en: We don't know a ton about that today.
sentences.zh: 我们今天对这方面了解不多。

sentences.en: But what we do know is that what Flynn has is good enough for Mueller and the Justice Department
sentences.zh: 但我们确实知道的是，弗林拥有的东西足够好，足以让穆勒和司法部

sentences.en: to offer him a plea agreement, something that they would not do unless they thought he really had something to tell them.
sentences.zh: 向他提供认罪协议，如果他们不认为他真的有什么要告诉他们的，他们是不会这样做的。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mike.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: Shortly after Flynn appeared in court on
sentences.zh: 在弗林出庭后不久，

sentences.en: Friday, Ty Cobb, the president's lawyer dealing with the Russia inquiry, played down the potential impact
sentences.zh: 即周五，负责处理涉俄调查的总统律师泰·科布淡化了

sentences.en: of Flynn's deal with federal authorities, saying he only served in the administration for a short time and had pled guilty to a single count of lying to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 弗林与联邦当局达成协议的潜在影响，称他在政府任职时间很短，并且对一项向联邦调查局撒谎的罪名认罪。

sentences.en: Nothing about the guilty plea or the charge implicates anyone other than Mr. Flynn, Cobb said in a statement, repeating the White House hope
sentences.zh: 科布在一份声明中重复了白宫的期望，即认罪或指控未牵涉弗林先生以外的任何人，

sentences.en: that Mueller would conclude the investigation quickly.
sentences.zh: 并希望穆勒能迅速结束调查。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know.
sentences.zh: 以下是你需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: This evening, Senate Republicans are expected to pass the most sweeping overhaul of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今晚，参议院共和党人预计将通过一代人以来对美国

sentences.en: tax code in a generation, potentially giving President Trump his first major legislative victory.
sentences.zh: 税法最大规模的全面修改，这可能为特朗普总统带来他的首个重大立法胜利。

sentences.en: On Thursday, Republicans had suffered an unexpected setback when a congressional committee announced
sentences.zh: 周四，当一个国会委员会宣布

sentences.en: that the plan would create a trillion-dollar deficit over the next 10 years, prompting several senators to withhold their support.
sentences.zh: 该计划将在未来10年内产生一万亿美元的赤字时，共和党人遭遇了意料之外的挫折，这促使几位参议员暂不支持该法案。

sentences.en: But after a series of last-minute changes designed to win over the holdout,
sentences.zh: 但在经过一系列旨在争取观望者的最后一刻修改后，

sentences.en: Senators Susan Collins of Maine, Jeff Flake of Arizona, Steve Daines of Montana, and Ron Johnson of Wisconsin, all said they would back the bill.
sentences.zh: 来自缅因州的参议员苏珊·柯林斯、亚利桑那州的杰夫·弗雷克、蒙大拿州的史蒂夫·戴恩斯以及威斯康星州的罗恩·约翰逊都表示他们将支持该法案。

sentences.en: We have the votes, said Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell.
sentences.zh: 我们有足够的票数，参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔说道。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是本期《每日简报》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目中，我们将为假期招待客人做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们对光线敏感而必须完全黑暗才能入睡吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们喝到不省人事才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有什么过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。

sentences.zh: 让痛苦随风而去吧。
